title: dipteronia sinensis subsp. dyeriana
intro: Dipteronia sinensis subsp. dyeriana, commonly known as Dyer's Oak, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and fever, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dyer's Oak include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Dyer's Oak have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-viral activities.
